notes: §1985:XIV.3.6.3 SR3: "Identifier-3 must reference an integer data item." CommunicationBinder#ScreenSendAdvancing refuses (COBOL6171, quoting the 1985 rule at --std 85) an operand IsIntegerItem rejects: a data item asks the one integer classifier IntrinsicResultType#IsIntegerOperand, which refuses a reference-modified item (class and category alphanumeric, §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5), an index data item and a non-integer PICTURE; a counter register passes through its implicit description; an index-name, a function and a symbolic-character are refused (kb/Work PB5384, PB5289). Probes at --std 85 on this tree: N2 (2:1) refused COBOL6171; LINAGE-COUNTER of a LINAGE IS 60 file accepted and ran; MSG (PIC X) refused.

next.reason: 1985: "Identifier-3 must reference an integer data item."; 2023: "2023 SEND (14.9.38) sends to a message server via literal-1/identifier-1; it has no ADVANCING phrase and no identifier-3 operand". The 1985 SEND identifier-3 is the ADVANCING line count of the communication module. 2023's SEND is a message-server statement with no advancing operand. WRITE's similar rule belongs to another statement.
